name: VRM_MEA_DOC_ACTION_HISTORY
description: VRM_MEA_DOC_ACTION_HISTORY contains action history of multiple element arrangements at both header and line level.

columns.name: MEA_ACTION_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of an action history entry.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: A flag that indicates if the recorded history is related to MEA header or line, where H indicates header and L indicates line level.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the MEA header or MEA line.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the action was performed.

columns.name: MEA_ACTION
columns.description: Action detail of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who performed an action.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE_STATUS
columns.description: Compliance status of a MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_COMPLIANCE_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STATUS
columns.description: Adjustment status of MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_ADJ_STATUS.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TOKEN_MAP
columns.description: Description of the standalone items which are included in the MEA.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
